points.name: 能愿动词“要”表示想做某事
points.explainEn: Use 要 + verb to say you want or plan to do something.
points.structure: 主语 + 要 + 动词

examples.en: I want to go to Beijing.
I will go to work tomorrow.
We want to study Chinese.

exercises.q: 翻译：We want to go to the store tomorrow. (use 要)
exercises.body: We want to go to the store tomorrow. (use 要)

exercises.q: 翻译：I want to buy a new phone. (use 要)
exercises.body: I want to buy a new phone. (use 要)

points.note: HSK2里“要”常表示愿望、计划；否定愿望可用“不想/不要”，语境要自然。
points.structureEn: Subject + yào (“want / plan to”) + Verb
points.noteEn: In HSK2, 要 often means want/plan; negate the wish with 不想/不要 as context fits.

points.name: 程度副词“最”
points.explainEn: Use 最 before an adjective or verb to mean “the most / best”.
points.structure: 最 + 形容词 / 动词

examples.en: September is the best time to visit Beijing.
examples.py: jiǔ yuè qù běijīng zuì hǎo.

examples.en: I like apples the most.
She is the tallest in our class.
examples.py: tā shì wǒmen bān zuì gāo de.

exercises.q: 翻译：This one is the best.
exercises.body: This one is the best.

exercises.q: 翻译：My younger sister likes cats the most.
exercises.body: My younger sister likes cats the most.

points.note: “最”表示在几个对象中程度最高。
points.structureEn: zuì (“the most / -est”) + Adjective / Verb
points.noteEn: 最 marks the highest degree among several things.

points.name: 概数：“几 / 多”表示大约数量
points.explainEn: Use 几 or 多 to give an approximate number.
points.structure: 十几 / 二十多 / 几十

examples.en: He is in his twenties.
I have more than ten friends.
examples.py: wǒ yǒu shí jǐ ge péngyou.

examples.en: There are more than thirty people here.

exercises.q: 翻译：There are more than ten people in the classroom.
exercises.body: There are more than ten people in the classroom.

exercises.q: 翻译：My dad is in his forties. (use 多)
exercises.body: My dad is in his forties. (use 多)

points.note: “十几”通常约11–19；“二十多”表示20以上、不满30。
points.structureEn: shí jǐ / èrshí duō / jǐ shí = about 10–19 / 20+ / tens of
points.noteEn: 十几 is roughly 11–19; 二十多 means over 20 but under 30.

points.name: 正反疑问句“是不是”
points.explainEn: Use 是不是 to ask for confirmation: “is it / are you … or not?”
points.structure: 主语 + 是不是 + …？

examples.en: Are you a student?
Is he very busy?
examples.py: tā shì bu shì hěn máng?

examples.en: Is tomorrow Saturday?

exercises.q: 翻译：Is your older sister a doctor?
exercises.body: Is your older sister a doctor?

exercises.q: 翻译：Is it cold outside? (use 是不是)
exercises.body: Is it cold outside? (use 是不是)

points.note: “是不是”比单纯“吗”更有确认语气。
points.structureEn: Subject + shì bu shì (“is / are ... or not?”) + ...?
points.noteEn: 是不是 carries more of a "confirm it, right?" tone than plain 吗.

points.name: 代词“每”表示每一个
points.explainEn: Use 每 before a time word or measure word to mean “every / each”.
points.structure: 每 + 时间词 / 量词 + 名词

examples.en: I get up at six every day.
He exercises every week.
Everyone has a name.
examples.py: měi ge rén dōu yǒu míngzi.

exercises.q: 翻译：My mom goes to the store every week.
exercises.a: 我妈妈每星期都去商店。
exercises.body: My mom goes to the store every week.

exercises.q: 翻译：Every cup is very expensive.
exercises.body: Every cup is very expensive.

points.note: “每”常和“都”一起出现：每个人都……
points.structureEn: měi (“every / each”) + Time word / Measure word + Noun
points.noteEn: 每 often pairs with 都: 每个人都… (everyone…).

points.name: 疑问代词“多 + 形容词”询问程度
points.explainEn: Use 多 + adjective to ask about degree, size, age, distance, etc.
points.structure: 多 + 形容词？

examples.en: How tall are you?
How far is your home from school?
examples.py: nǐ jiā lí xuéxiào duō yuǎn?

examples.en: How old is your younger brother?

exercises.q: 翻译：How far is the hospital from here?
exercises.body: How far is the hospital from here?

exercises.q: 翻译：How old is your daughter?
exercises.body: How old is your daughter?

points.note: 常见搭配：多大、多高、多远、多久（更高等级会继续扩展）。
points.structureEn: duō (“how”) + Adjective?
points.noteEn: Common pairings: 多大/多高/多远/多久 (expanded at higher levels).

lessons.title: 左边那个红色的是我的

points.name: “的”字短语：省略中心语
points.explainEn: Use 的 to replace a noun when the noun is already clear.
points.structure: 修饰语 + 的

examples.en: The red one is mine.
The one on the left is the teacher’s.
examples.py: zuǒbian nà ge shì lǎoshī de.

examples.en: The big one looks nice.

exercises.q: 翻译：The white one is my older brother's.
exercises.body: The white one is my older brother's.

exercises.q: 翻译：I want to buy the small one.
exercises.body: I want to buy the small one.

points.note: “的”后面的名词可以省略，但听话人必须知道说的是什么。
points.structureEn: Modifier + de = “the ... one / someone’s”
points.noteEn: The noun after 的 can be dropped if the listener knows what is meant.

points.name: “动词 + 一下”表示动作短、轻
points.explainEn: Use verb + 一下 to make an action sound short, light, or polite.
points.structure: 动词 + 一下

examples.en: Take a quick look.
Please wait a moment.
I want to rest for a moment.

exercises.q: 翻译：Can you help me for a moment?
exercises.body: Can you help me for a moment?

exercises.q: 翻译：Please wash your hands. (use 一下)
exercises.body: Please wash your hands. (use 一下)

points.note: 常用于请求，语气比只说动词更柔和。
points.structureEn: Verb + yíxià = do something briefly / for a moment
points.noteEn: Often used for requests; softer than just saying the verb.

points.name: 副词“真”表示感叹
points.explainEn: Use 真 before an adjective to strongly say “really / so”.
points.structure: 真 + 形容词

examples.en: You are so nice!
These clothes are really pretty!
It is really cold today!

exercises.q: 翻译：This is really good!
exercises.body: This is really good!

exercises.q: 翻译：This cup of coffee is really expensive!
exercises.body: This cup of coffee is really expensive!

points.note: “真”常带感叹语气。
points.structureEn: zhēn (“really / so”) + Adjective
points.noteEn: 真 usually carries an exclamatory tone.

lessons.title: 这个工作是他帮我介绍的

points.name: “是……的”强调动作的执行者
points.explainEn: Use 是…的 to emphasize who did a completed action.
points.structure: 主语 + 是 + 人 + 动词 + 的

examples.zh: 这个工作是他帮我介绍的。
examples.en: He was the one who introduced this job to me.
examples.py: zhè ge gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de.

examples.en: The teacher was the one who gave me this book.
examples.py: zhè běn shū shì lǎoshī gěi wǒ de.

examples.en: Mom was the one who made dinner.

exercises.q: 翻译：This cup was given to me by my friend.
exercises.a: 这个杯子是我朋友送我的。
exercises.body: This cup was given to me by my friend.

exercises.q: 翻译：Dad was the one who bought this computer.
exercises.body: Dad was the one who bought this computer.

points.note: 用于已经发生的事情，强调“谁做的”。
points.structureEn: Subject + shì + Person + Verb + de = “It was [person] who ...”
points.noteEn: Used for a past event, stressing "who did it".

points.name: 时间结构“……的时候”
points.explainEn: Use …的时候 to mean “when / at the time of …”.
points.structure: 动作 / 时间 + 的时候

examples.en: I watch TV when I eat.
examples.py: wǒ chīfàn de shíhou kàn diànshì.

examples.en: Do not talk during class.
examples.py: shàngkè de shíhou bú yào shuōhuà.

examples.zh: 我到家的时候，他在看书。
examples.en: When I got home, he was reading.
examples.py: wǒ dào jiā de shíhou, tā zài kàn shū.

exercises.q: 翻译：When I was in Beijing, I often went running.
exercises.a: 我在北京的时候经常跑步。
exercises.body: When I was in Beijing, I often went running.

exercises.q: 翻译：When it rains, I don't go out.
exercises.body: When it rains, I don't go out.

points.note: “的时候”前面可以放时间、动作或小句。
points.structureEn: Action / Time + de shíhou = “when / while ...”
points.noteEn: Before …的时候 you can put a time, an action or a clause.

points.name: 副词“已经”表示动作已发生
points.explainEn: Use 已经 to mean “already”. It often appears with 了.
points.structure: 已经 + 动词 + 了

examples.en: I have already eaten.
He has already arrived in Beijing.
The movie has already started.

exercises.q: 翻译：He has already gone home.
exercises.body: He has already gone home.

exercises.q: 翻译：I have already bought the tickets.
exercises.body: I have already bought the tickets.

points.note: 常见结构：已经……了。
points.structureEn: yǐjīng (“already”) + Verb + le
points.noteEn: Common pattern: 已经…了.

points.name: 副词“就”表示很快、很早或紧接着
points.explainEn: Use 就 to show something happens early, quickly, or right after something else.
points.structure: 时间 / 条件 + 就 + 动词

examples.en: I will arrive in just five minutes.
He got up as early as six.
examples.py: tā liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.

examples.en: I go to school right after eating.
examples.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù xuéxiào.

exercises.q: 翻译：I'll come right after work.
exercises.body: I'll come right after work.

exercises.q: 翻译：He went to bed as early as nine o'clock.
exercises.body: He went to bed as early as nine o'clock.

points.note: “就”常表达“早、快、顺利、紧接着”。
points.structureEn: Time / Condition + jiù + Verb = happen early / quickly / right then
points.noteEn: 就 often conveys early / quick / smooth / right after.

points.name: 副词“还”表示仍然、还没有变化
points.explainEn: Use 还 to mean “still / yet”.
points.structure: 还 + 动词 / 形容词

examples.en: He is still at school.
I have not eaten yet.
It is still cold today.

exercises.q: 翻译：My son hasn't gotten up yet.
exercises.body: My son hasn't gotten up yet.

exercises.q: 翻译：The tea is still hot.
exercises.body: The tea is still hot.

points.note: “还没……” = “not yet”.
points.structureEn: hái (“still / yet”) + Verb / Adjective
points.noteEn: 还没… = "not yet".

points.name: “有点儿 + 形容词”表示轻微、不太满意
points.explainEn: Use 有点儿 before an adjective for “a little”, often with a negative feeling.
points.structure: 有点儿 + 形容词

examples.en: It is a little cold today.
This dish is a little expensive.
I am a little tired.

exercises.q: 翻译：This cup of coffee is a bit hot.
exercises.body: This cup of coffee is a bit hot.

exercises.q: 翻译：This room is a bit small.
exercises.body: This room is a bit small.

points.note: “有点儿”通常放在形容词前。
points.structureEn: yǒudiǎnr (“a little”) + Adjective
points.noteEn: 有点儿 usually goes before an adjective.

points.name: 疑问代词“怎么”询问原因
points.explainEn: Use 怎么 before a negative or unexpected action to ask “why / how come”.
points.structure: 怎么 + 不 / 没 + 动词？

examples.en: Why did you stop eating?
Why did he not come?
Why are you unhappy?

exercises.q: 翻译：Why aren't you going to school?
exercises.body: Why aren't you going to school?

exercises.q: 翻译：Why didn't you call me?
exercises.body: Why didn't you call me?

points.note: HSK1的“怎么”主要问方法；这里学习“怎么”问原因。
points.structureEn: zěnme (“why / how come”) + bù / méi + Verb?
points.noteEn: HSK1's 怎么 asks "how"; here 怎么 asks "why".

points.name: 量词重叠表示“每一个”
points.explainEn: Repeat a measure word to mean “every one / each one”.
points.structure: 量词 + 量词 + 都……

examples.zh: 我们班的学生个个都很好。
examples.en: Every student in our class is good.
examples.py: wǒmen bān de xuésheng gègè dōu hěn hǎo.

examples.en: Every apple is big.
examples.py: zhèxiē píngguǒ gègè dōu hěn dà.

examples.en: Everyone is happy.
examples.py: zhèxiē rén gègè dōu hěn gāoxìng.

exercises.q: 翻译：Every one of his friends is tall. (use 个个)
exercises.body: Every one of his friends is tall. (use 个个)

exercises.q: 翻译：Every one of these clothes is pretty. (use 件件)
exercises.a: 这些衣服件件都很漂亮。
exercises.body: Every one of these clothes is pretty. (use 件件)

points.note: HSK2重点掌握“个个”；常和“都”搭配。
points.structureEn: Measure word + Measure word + dōu ... = every single ...
points.noteEn: Focus on 个个 here; it often pairs with 都.

points.name: “因为……所以……”表示原因和结果
points.explainEn: Use 因为…所以… for “because… so…”.
points.structure: 因为 + 原因，所以 + 结果

examples.en: Because it rained, I did not go.
examples.py: yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù.

examples.en: Because he was busy, he did not come.
examples.py: yīnwèi tā hěn máng, suǒyǐ méi lái.

examples.zh: 因为我喜欢汉语，所以每天学习。
examples.en: Because I like Chinese, I study every day.
examples.py: yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuan hànyǔ, suǒyǐ měitiān xuéxí.

exercises.q: 翻译：Because he likes football, he plays it every day.
exercises.a: 因为他喜欢踢足球，所以每天都踢。
exercises.body: Because he likes football, he plays it every day.

exercises.q: 翻译：Because I was sick, I didn't go to class.
exercises.a: 因为我生病了，所以没去上课。
exercises.body: Because I was sick, I didn't go to class.

points.note: 口语里有时可省略“因为”或“所以”，初学先掌握完整结构。
points.structureEn: yīnwèi + Reason, suǒyǐ + Result = “Because ..., so ...”
points.noteEn: In speech 因为 or 所以 can be dropped; beginners should learn the full pattern first.

points.name: 副词“还”表示状态继续
points.explainEn: Use 还 to show a state continues: “still”.
points.structure: 还 + 在 / 形容词 / 动词

examples.en: He is still sleeping.
I am still at the company.
It is still cold outside.

exercises.q: 翻译：It is still raining outside.
exercises.body: It is still raining outside.

exercises.q: 翻译：Dad is still working.
exercises.body: Dad is still working.

points.note: 本课强调“状态还在继续”。
points.structureEn: hái (“still”) + zài / Adjective / Verb
points.noteEn: This lesson stresses that a state is still continuing.

points.name: 副词“就”表示比预期早、快
points.explainEn: Use 就 when something happens earlier or faster than expected.
points.structure: 时间 / 条件 + 就 + 结果

examples.en: I arrived in only ten minutes.
examples.py: wǒ shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.

examples.en: He came as early as seven.
examples.py: tā qī diǎn jiù lái le.

examples.en: She understood as soon as she looked.
examples.py: tā yí kàn jiù dǒng le.

exercises.q: 翻译：She finished reading this book in just one day.
exercises.a: 这本书她一天就看完了。
exercises.body: She finished reading this book in just one day.

exercises.q: 翻译：The bus came in just five minutes.
exercises.a: 公共汽车五分钟就来了。
exercises.body: The bus came in just five minutes.

points.note: 和“才”形成对比会在更高等级继续学习。
points.structureEn: Time / Condition + jiù + Result = earlier / faster than expected
points.noteEn: The contrast with 才 is studied further at higher levels.

points.name: 动词“离”表示两地距离
points.explainEn: Use A 离 B + far/near to say the distance between two places.
points.structure: A + 离 + B + 远 / 近

examples.en: My home is close to the school.
examples.py: wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.

examples.en: Is the company far from here?
Beijing is far from Shanghai.

exercises.q: 翻译：Is the airport far from your home?
exercises.body: Is the airport far from your home?

exercises.q: 翻译：The store is very close to my home.
exercises.body: The store is very close to my home.

points.note: “离”后面放参照地点。
points.structureEn: A + lí + B + yuǎn / jìn = A is far from / near B
points.noteEn: Put the reference place after 离.

points.name: 语气助词“呢”表示动作正在进行或状态持续
points.explainEn: Use 呢 at the end to show an action/state is continuing, often with 在/正在.
points.structure: 在 / 正在 + 动词 + 呢

examples.en: He is sleeping right now.
I am reading right now.
The teacher is teaching now.

exercises.q: 翻译：Mom is washing clothes right now.
exercises.body: Mom is washing clothes right now.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older brother is playing basketball right now.
exercises.body: My older brother is playing basketball right now.

points.note: 本课“呢”强调当前动作或状态。
points.structureEn: zài / zhèngzài + Verb + ne = be doing ... right now
points.noteEn: Here 呢 stresses the current action or state.

points.name: “……，好吗？”征求意见
points.explainEn: Add 好吗？ to a suggestion to ask “okay?”.
points.structure: 建议句 + ，好吗？

examples.en: Let’s go tomorrow, okay?
Wait for me a moment, okay?
examples.py: nǐ děng wǒ yíxià, hǎo ma?

examples.en: Let’s eat together, okay?

exercises.q: 翻译：Let's go running tomorrow morning, okay?
exercises.a: 我们明天早上去跑步，好吗？
exercises.body: Let's go running tomorrow morning, okay?

exercises.q: 翻译：Let's take a taxi, okay?
exercises.body: Let's take a taxi, okay?

points.note: 语气比较柔和，常用于建议或请求。
points.structureEn: Suggestion + hǎo ma? = “..., okay?”
points.noteEn: The tone is soft; often used for suggestions or requests.

points.name: 副词“再”表示以后重复或下一步
points.explainEn: Use 再 for an action that will happen again or later.
points.structure: 再 + 动词

examples.en: Please say it again.
We will go again tomorrow.
Let me think, then I will tell you.

exercises.q: 翻译：Let's eat first and then go.
exercises.body: Let's eat first and then go.

exercises.q: 翻译：I want to see this movie again.
exercises.a: 这个电影我想再看一次。
exercises.body: I want to see this movie again.

exercises.q: 翻译：Let's talk about it tomorrow.
exercises.body: Let's talk about it tomorrow.

points.note: “再”多用于还没有发生的重复；“又”多用于已经发生的重复。
points.structureEn: zài (“again / later / then”) + Verb
points.noteEn: 再 is for repetition not yet happened; 又 is for repetition already happened.

points.name: 兼语句：“让 / 请 / 叫 + 人 + 动词”
points.explainEn: Use 让/请/叫 + person + verb to ask or make someone do something.
points.structure: 让 / 请 / 叫 + 人 + 动词

examples.en: Mom asks me to come home early.
examples.py: māma ràng wǒ zǎodiǎnr huí jiā.

examples.en: The teacher asks us to read.
He tells me to wait a moment.

exercises.q: 翻译：My friend invited me to see a movie.
exercises.body: My friend invited me to see a movie.

exercises.q: 翻译：The doctor told me to rest more. (use 让)
exercises.body: The doctor told me to rest more. (use 让)

exercises.q: 翻译：Mom told me to go buy some fruit. (use 叫)
exercises.body: Mom told me to go buy some fruit. (use 叫)

points.note: 本级先掌握最常见的“让、请、叫 + 人 + 动词”。
points.structureEn: ràng / qǐng / jiào + Person + Verb = let / ask / tell someone to ...
points.noteEn: At this level master the common 让/请/叫 + person + verb.

points.name: 动词重叠表示动作短、尝试一下
points.explainEn: Repeat a verb to make the action sound short, light, or like “try”.
points.structure: AA / A一A

examples.en: Let me think for a moment.
Take a look at this book.
Please give it a try.

exercises.q: 翻译：I'll ask him. (repeat the verb)
exercises.body: I'll ask him. (repeat the verb)

exercises.q: 翻译：You should rest a bit. (repeat the verb)
exercises.body: You should rest a bit. (repeat the verb)

points.note: 单音节动词常用AA或A一A；语气轻松。
points.structureEn: AA / A-yī-A = do something briefly / try doing it
points.noteEn: Monosyllabic verbs use AA or A一A; the tone is casual.

points.name: 结果补语：完、懂、到、错等
points.explainEn: Put a result word after a verb to show the result of the action.
points.structure: 动词 + 结果补语

examples.en: I finished my homework.
I understood what I heard.
I found my phone.

exercises.q: 翻译：I have finished reading this book.
exercises.body: I have finished reading this book.

exercises.q: 翻译：I wrote this character wrong.
exercises.body: I wrote this character wrong.

points.note: HSK2常见：看见、听懂、做完、写错、找到。
points.structureEn: Verb + Result complement = action + result (finish / understand / find ...)
points.noteEn: Common in HSK2: 看见, 听懂, 做完, 写错, 找到.

points.name: 介词“从”表示起点
points.explainEn: Use 从 before a place or time to mean “from”.
points.structure: 从 + 起点 + 到 + 终点

examples.en: I come from Beijing.
I walk from home to school.
examples.py: wǒ cóng jiā zǒu dào xuéxiào.

examples.zh: 从今天开始，我每天运动。
examples.en: Starting today, I exercise every day.
examples.py: cóng jīntiān kāishǐ, wǒ měitiān yùndòng.

exercises.q: 翻译：It takes one hour from my home to the company.
exercises.a: 从我家到公司要一个小时。
exercises.body: It takes one hour from my home to the company.

exercises.q: 翻译：We work from nine to five.
exercises.a: 我们从九点到五点工作。
exercises.body: We work from nine to five.

points.note: “从”可以介绍地点、时间或过程的起点。
points.structureEn: cóng + Starting point + dào + End point = “from ... to ...”
points.noteEn: 从 introduces the starting point of a place, time or process.

points.name: “第 + 数词”表示顺序
points.explainEn: Put 第 before a number to mean “first, second, third…”.
points.structure: 第 + 数词 (+ 量词/名词)

examples.en: This is Lesson 1.
He was the first to come.
examples.py: tā shì dì yī ge lái de.

examples.zh: 今天是我们认识的第一天。
examples.en: Today is the first day we have known each other.
examples.py: jīntiān shì wǒmen rènshi de dì yī tiān.

exercises.q: 翻译：This is my first time coming to China.
exercises.body: This is my first time coming to China.

exercises.q: 翻译：The second question is wrong.
exercises.body: The second question is wrong.

points.note: “第”把基数词变成序数词。
points.structureEn: dì + Number (+ Measure word / Noun) = ordinal number (1st, 2nd, 3rd ...)
points.noteEn: 第 turns a cardinal number into an ordinal.

lessons.title: 别找了，手机在桌子上呢

points.name: 禁止祈使句“别 / 不要……了”
points.explainEn: Use 别 or 不要 to tell someone not to do something. Add 了 when asking them to stop.
points.structure: 别 / 不要 + 动词 (+ 了)

examples.en: Stop looking.
Stop watching TV.
Do not talk.

exercises.q: 翻译：Don't go out, it's raining.
exercises.body: Don't go out, it's raining.

exercises.q: 翻译：Don't buy it, it's too expensive.
exercises.body: Don't buy it, it's too expensive.

points.note: “别”更口语；“不要”也很常用。
points.structureEn: bié / bú yào + Verb (+ le) = “Don’t ... / Stop ...”
points.noteEn: 别 is more colloquial; 不要 is also very common.

points.name: 介词“对”引出对象
points.explainEn: Use 对 + person/thing before an adjective or verb to show the target: “to / toward / about”.
points.structure: 对 + 人/事物 + 谓语

examples.en: The teacher is very good to the students.
He is serious about his work.
This exercise is good for the body.
examples.py: zhè ge yùndòng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.

exercises.q: 翻译：Drinking more water is good for your health.
exercises.body: Drinking more water is good for your health.

exercises.q: 翻译：He smiled at me.
exercises.body: He smiled at me.

points.note: “对”后面是动作、态度或评价所针对的对象。
points.structureEn: duì + Person / Thing + Predicate = to / toward / about ...
points.noteEn: After 对 comes the target of the action, attitude or judgement.

points.name: 动词短语作定语：“……的 + 名词”
points.explainEn: Put a verb phrase + 的 before a noun to describe the noun.
points.structure: 动词短语 + 的 + 名词

examples.zh: 那个唱歌的人是我朋友。
examples.en: The person singing is my friend.
examples.py: nà ge chànggē de rén shì wǒ péngyou.

examples.en: This is the book I bought yesterday.
examples.py: zhè shì wǒ zuótiān mǎi de shū.

examples.zh: 教我们汉语的老师姓王。
examples.en: The teacher who teaches us Chinese is surnamed Wang.
examples.py: jiāo wǒmen hànyǔ de lǎoshī xìng wáng.

exercises.q: 翻译：The person who is driving is my husband.
exercises.body: The person who is driving is my husband.

exercises.q: 翻译：The movie I saw yesterday was very interesting.
exercises.a: 我昨天看的电影很有意思。
exercises.body: The movie I saw yesterday was very interesting.

points.note: 定语较长时，“的”通常不能省。
points.structureEn: Verb phrase + de + Noun = the Noun who / that ...
points.noteEn: When the modifier is long, 的 usually cannot be dropped.

points.name: “比”字句表示比较
points.explainEn: Use A 比 B + adjective to say A is more … than B.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 形容词 (+ 数量)

examples.en: He is three years older than me.
examples.py: tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.

examples.en: Today is colder than yesterday.
This item of clothing is cheaper than that one.
examples.py: zhè jiàn yīfu bǐ nà jiàn piányi.

exercises.q: 翻译：Coffee is more expensive than tea.
exercises.body: Coffee is more expensive than tea.

exercises.q: 翻译：My younger brother is taller than me.
exercises.body: My younger brother is taller than me.

points.note: “比”字句里形容词前一般不用“很”。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + Adjective (+ Amount) = A is ...er than B
points.noteEn: In a 比 sentence, don't put 很 before the adjective.

points.name: 能愿动词“可能”表示推测
points.explainEn: Use 可能 to say something is possible or probably true.
points.structure: 主语 + 可能 + 谓语

examples.en: He may be a teacher.
It may rain tomorrow.
She may not come.

exercises.q: 翻译：He might be at the hospital now.
exercises.body: He might be at the hospital now.

exercises.q: 翻译：She might not know.
exercises.body: She might not know.

points.note: “可能”表示不确定的判断。
points.structureEn: Subject + kěnéng + Predicate = may / might / probably ...
points.noteEn: 可能 expresses an uncertain judgement.

points.name: 状态补语：“动词 + 得 + 形容词”
points.explainEn: Use 得 after a verb to describe how well, fast, much, etc. an action is done.
points.structure: 动词 + 得 + 形容词

examples.en: He speaks Chinese very well.
examples.py: tā shuō hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.

examples.en: She runs very fast.
You write very clearly.

exercises.q: 翻译：She speaks very well.
exercises.body: She speaks very well.

exercises.q: 翻译：My dad drives very slowly.
exercises.body: My dad drives very slowly.

points.note: 有宾语时常重复动词：他说汉语说得很好。
points.structureEn: Verb + de + Adjective = describe how well / fast / clearly an action is done
points.noteEn: With an object the verb is repeated: 他说汉语说得很好.

points.name: “比”字句表示程度差：“多 / 一点儿 / 多了”
points.explainEn: Add 多、一点儿 or 多了 after the adjective to show how much more.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 形容词 + 多 / 一点儿 / 多了

examples.en: Today is much colder than yesterday.
examples.py: jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng duō le.

examples.en: He is a little taller than me.
This one is much more expensive than that one.
examples.py: zhè jiàn bǐ nà jiàn guì duō le.

exercises.q: 翻译：My home is a little farther away than his.
exercises.body: My home is a little farther away than his.

exercises.q: 翻译：This apple is much bigger than that one.
exercises.a: 这个苹果比那个大多了。
exercises.body: This apple is much bigger than that one.

points.note: 本课是在基本“比”字句上的程度扩展。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + Adjective + duō / yìdiǎnr / duō le = much / a little more ...
points.noteEn: This extends the basic 比 sentence to express degree of difference.

points.name: 动态助词“着”表示状态持续
points.explainEn: Use 着 after a verb to show a state continues.
points.structure: 动词 + 着

examples.en: The door is open.
There is a book lying on the table.
examples.py: zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yì běn shū.

examples.en: He is holding a phone in his hand.

exercises.q: 翻译：She is wearing red clothes.
exercises.body: She is wearing red clothes.

exercises.q: 翻译：He is sitting and watching TV.
exercises.body: He is sitting and watching TV.

points.note: “着”强调状态持续；不要和“正在……呢”的进行动作混淆。
points.structureEn: Verb + zhe = the state continues / be in a continuing state
points.noteEn: 着 stresses a continuing state; don't confuse it with the ongoing action 正在…呢.

points.name: 反问句“不是……吗？”
points.explainEn: Use 不是…吗？ to remind, confirm, or show surprise: “isn’t it…?”
points.structure: 不是 + … + 吗？

examples.en: Aren’t you a teacher?
Didn’t he come yesterday?
examples.py: tā bú shì zuótiān lái de ma?

examples.en: Isn’t this your book?
examples.py: zhè bú shì nǐ de shū ma?

exercises.q: 翻译：Didn't you buy a new phone?
exercises.body: Didn't you buy a new phone?

exercises.q: 翻译：Isn't today your birthday?
exercises.body: Isn't today your birthday?

points.note: 形式是疑问，常带“我以为是这样”的语气。
points.structureEn: bú shì + ... + ma? = “Isn’t / Wasn’t ...?”
points.noteEn: It looks like a question but carries an "I thought so" tone.

points.name: 介词“往”表示方向
points.explainEn: Use 往 + direction + verb to mean “toward / in the direction of”.
points.structure: 往 + 方向 + 动词

examples.en: Please walk forward.
Look to the right.
Go left from here.

exercises.q: 翻译：Walk straight ahead and you'll see the hospital.
exercises.body: Walk straight ahead and you'll see the hospital.

exercises.q: 翻译：At the intersection, go right. (use 往)
exercises.body: At the intersection, go right. (use 往)

points.note: “往”后面常接前、后、左、右等方向词。
points.structureEn: wǎng + Direction + Verb = Verb toward / in the direction of ...
points.noteEn: 往 is often followed by a direction word: 前/后/左/右.

points.name: 动态助词“过”表示过去经验
points.explainEn: Use 过 after a verb to say you have had an experience before.
points.structure: 动词 + 过 + 宾语

examples.en: I have been to Beijing.
Have you seen this movie?
examples.py: nǐ kànguo zhè ge diànyǐng ma?

examples.en: I have never eaten this dish.
examples.py: wǒ méi chīguo zhè ge cài.

exercises.q: 翻译：Have you ever taken a plane?
exercises.body: Have you ever taken a plane?

exercises.q: 翻译：I have never been to his home.
exercises.body: I have never been to his home.

points.note: 否定常用“没(有) + 动词 + 过”。
points.structureEn: Verb + guo + Object = have ever done / have experienced ...
points.noteEn: The negative is usually 没(有) + verb + 过.

points.name: “虽然……但是……”表示转折
points.explainEn: Use 虽然…但是… for “although…but…”.
points.structure: 虽然 + 情况，但是 + 相反/不同结果

examples.zh: 虽然很冷，但是他去跑步了。
examples.en: Although it was cold, he went running.
examples.py: suīrán hěn lěng, dànshì tā qù pǎobù le.

examples.zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他来了。
examples.en: Although he was busy, he came.
examples.py: suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā lái le.

examples.zh: 这个菜虽然贵，但是很好吃。
examples.en: Although this dish is expensive, it is delicious.
examples.py: zhè ge cài suīrán guì, dànshì hěn hǎochī.

exercises.q: 翻译：Although he is tall, he doesn't play basketball.
exercises.a: 虽然他很高，但是他不打篮球。
exercises.body: Although he is tall, he doesn't play basketball.

exercises.q: 翻译：Although it's snowing, it's not cold.
exercises.body: Although it's snowing, it's not cold.

points.note: “虽然”说明让步条件，“但是”引出转折结果。
points.structureEn: suīrán + Situation, dànshì + Contrasting result = “Although ..., but ...”
points.noteEn: 虽然 states a concession; 但是 introduces the contrasting result.

points.name: 动量补语“次”表示动作次数
points.explainEn: Use 次 after a number to count how many times an action happens.
points.structure: 动词 + 数字 + 次

examples.en: I have been to Beijing twice.
I have seen this movie three times.
examples.py: zhè ge diànyǐng wǒ kànguo sān cì.

examples.en: How many times have you been here?

exercises.q: 翻译：I have called him twice.
exercises.body: I have called him twice.

exercises.q: 翻译：I went to the airport twice yesterday.
exercises.body: I went to the airport twice yesterday.

points.note: “次”是最常用的动作次数量词。
points.structureEn: Verb + Number + cì = do something N times
points.noteEn: 次 is the most common measure word for number of times.

points.name: “要 / 快要 / 就要……了”表示马上发生
points.explainEn: Use 要/快要/就要…了 for something that will happen very soon.
points.structure: 要 / 快要 / 就要 + 动词/变化 + 了

examples.en: The New Year is coming soon.
The movie is about to start.
It is going to rain.

exercises.q: 翻译：My birthday is coming soon.
exercises.body: My birthday is coming soon.

exercises.q: 翻译：Class is about to start.
exercises.body: Class is about to start.

exercises.q: 翻译：He is leaving tomorrow. (use 就要)
exercises.body: He is leaving tomorrow. (use 就要)

points.note: 表示临近发生；“快要/就要”更强调“马上”。
points.structureEn: yào / kuài yào / jiù yào + Verb / Change + le = be about to ...
points.noteEn: Shows something is about to happen; 快要/就要 stresses "very soon".

points.name: “都……了”表示“已经到了这种程度”
points.explainEn: Use 都…了 to mean “already”, often with surprise, urgency, or a reminder.
points.structure: 都 + 时间/数量/状态 + 了

examples.en: It is already ten; go to sleep.
examples.py: dōu shí diǎn le, kuài shuìjiào ba.

examples.en: You are already twenty.
We have already waited for half an hour.
examples.py: wǒmen dōu děng le bàn xiǎoshí le.

exercises.q: 翻译：I've already drunk three cups of coffee. (use 都)
exercises.body: I've already drunk three cups of coffee. (use 都)

exercises.q: 翻译：It's already eleven o'clock and he still hasn't come. (use 都)
exercises.body: It's already eleven o'clock and he still hasn't come. (use 都)

points.note: 常带说话人的感情色彩：觉得时间晚、数量多、情况已经明显。
points.structureEn: dōu + Time / Number / State + le = “already ...” (often surprise / reminder)
points.noteEn: Carries the speaker's feeling: it's late, it's a lot, or it's already obvious.
